purpose: Dated primary-source reads performed by session 4901f43e through the authoring environment's fetch path, which reaches hosts the CI runner is refused on (hltv.org /team and /search answer 403 to the runner; egamersworld.com answers 403). Every entry records the URL, how the read was performed, what was actually on the page, the values taken from it, and a sha256 of the extracted text so a reviewer can confirm the file was not edited after the read.
time_basis_note: The authoring environment has no per-request clock export, so retrieved_at is the instant this file was written and read_not_before is a bound taken from evidence inside the response itself (a Polymarket updatedAt field, or an HLTV countdown against a known UTC start). Every read is same-day and far inside the repository's eight-hour evidence window.
policy: Hotspawn is inventory only and never a probability input. HLTV and Strafe crowd votes are recorded here to document that they were seen and rejected, never to price a match. No percentage in this file is inferred: each one is quoted from the source named in the same entry.
